input_contract.rooms: Polygon, type, height_m, occupants and parking_spaces where applicable.
input_contract.terminals: Manually positioned supply or extract grilles inside rooms.
input_contract.fans: Manually positioned supply or extract fan units.

output_contract.rooms: Area, volume, airflow direction, airflow and calculation basis.
output_contract.fans: Design airflow, connected terminals and longest routed run.
output_contract.sections: Network kind, airflow, length, velocity and rectangular dimensions in 5 cm steps.
output_contract.warnings: Missing data, scope conditions and project checks still required.
output_contract.source: Official source identifier, reference and verification date.
